meta.grouping: connected components over shared advisory id (display id + OSV aliases), shared repository, and near-duplicate code (identifier Jaccard >= 0.7, >= 5 identifiers); a vulnerable/fixed pair is one unit; whole components go to one side (203 components, largest 44 units, 0 near-duplicate links merged across otherwise separate components)

date_strata.definition: earliest of the fix commit's author/committer date (GitHub API cache) and the earliest OSV `published` over the advisory's aliases; CVE-id year as fallback. A lower bound on when the fixed code was public; pairs are stratified by its year and by language.
